questions.rationale: The student selected A, which states 'No labels in training data' — this actually describes unsupervised learning, not supervised learning. Supervised learning fundamentally relies on labeled training data to learn mappings from inputs to outputs. Without labels, the model cannot learn the correct target functions needed for prediction tasks like classification or regression.
